priorities.summary: Improper input validation in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway lets an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands on default deployments. Actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day before patches; Citrix released fixes on Sep 27, 2026 (14.1-73.37, 13.1-64.23).

Memory overflow in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway exploitable when DTLS is enabled (default for VPN virtual servers), enabling remote code execution or denial of service. Actively exploited in the wild; patched Sep 27, 2026 in the same fixed builds.

HTTP request smuggling in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway that can bypass security controls on front-end servers. Disclosed in the same Sep 27, 2026 Citrix bulletin alongside the two exploited zero-days; same fixed builds.

model.name: H Company Holo4
model.summary: A new series of agentic computer-use models in 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE sizes with open weights on Hugging Face. Holo4 27B scores 85.2% on OSWorld at $0.08/task — near frontier closed-model scores at a fraction of the cost — driving GUIs, code, MCP and APIs through one unified model.
